column3: Rosewood of a C3 marimba bar (Bork et al. 1999, "a real marimba bar of note C3" per Beaton 2022 pp.10-11), as Beaton and Scavone 2021 print it for their marimba F3 bar model; species, moisture and specimen not printed
column4: Printed constants, second hand: Beaton and Scavone 2021 Table II "Rosewood properties are adopted from the literature (Bork et al., 1999)"; how Bork et al. obtained each constant (measured, taken or adjusted) is not readable here, because Acustica (ingentaconnect) and AIP answered 403 to the project client on 2026-11-08
column5: Printed in bar axes, x length, y width, z thickness (Fig. 3 caption): rho 1080 kg/m3; E_x 23.0, E_y 2.3, E_z 1.15 GPa; nu xy 0.30, yz 0.60, xz 0.45; G xy 3.0, yz 1.0, xz 3.0 GPa. One nu per plane is printed; this pack reads the first index as the loaded direction (nu_lt = nu_xy, nu_lr = nu_xz, nu_tr = nu_yz), the only reading whose compliance is positive definite. Ratios are to E_x in the bar_strike slots: et_over_el = E_y/E_x (width), er_over_el = E_z/E_x (thickness), glt_over_el = G_xy/E_x, grt_over_el = G_yz/E_x, glr_over_el = G_xz/E_x. Which of width and thickness is the wood's radial direction is not printed; the slots follow the bar axes. No uncertainty printed
